verdicts.reason: A has no RSVP CTA and no logo. Its body copy and the 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' line are microscopic and unreadable at 320x50, and the pill row is jammed against the copy block. B keeps the RSVP button, the product can and the headline, but it is overstuffed. The headline sits at the far right after the date, so the reading order runs backwards. The subtitle and URL lines are illegibly tiny, and the date, can, pills and button are crammed together with no breathing room.
